5. /trace — shape (30000,) — dtype int64
6. /x — shape (384,) — dtype float32
7. /y — shape (384,) — dtype float32
8. /z — shape (384,) — dtype float32

Notes: /das is the main DAS strain-rate array (30,000 time samples x 384 channels); /t and /trace are per-time-sample vectors (time and trace index); /channel, /x, /y, /z are per-channel vectors (channel number and spatial coordinates); /crs is a scalar coordinate-reference-system field. The file was opened read-only and closed after inspection.
